newsitem.title: EGYPT: Mubarak says Europe essential to peace progress.
newsitem.headline: Mubarak says Europe essential to peace progress.

text.p: Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak said on Thursday an active European role was essential for progress in the Middle East peace process.

"It is necessary to have an active European role alongside the role of the United States in the peace process -- without Europe's role it will not be possible to achieve progress," Mubarak told reporters on a tour of satellite industrial cities.
Mubarak met Irish Foreign Minister Dick Spring in the northeastern city of Ismailia on Monday for talks on how Europe could galvanise the stalled talks.
Spring, whose country currently holds the rotating European Union presidency, was sent to the region by the EU to meet Israeli and Palestinian officials.
The Irish minister said Europe, frustrated at being cut out of the U.S.-brokered peace process, would work with Washington, not against it, to kick-start the talks.
Although the United States co-sponsored a 1991 peace conference in Madrid, its role in the region has traditionally been seen as tilted towards Israel.

Palestinian President Yasser Arafat stopped in France and Italy on his way home last week from an emergency meeting with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in Washington to ask for a European presence in talks with the Jewish state. REUTER
